title: 目標達成の後に・だって、ウマドル

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon is performing well in her races. As her popularity increases, so does the number of people who come to see her street performances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She comes to me with a shocking request, saying she wants to take on the Satsuki Sho for her next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not only is she ill-suited for running on turf, the Classic Triple Crown draws in the very best racers of each generation. Winning will be no easy feat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All the same, Smart Falcon insists on entering. She wants her fans to hear her sing a song that can only be sung on the Classic Triple Crown tour.
